name: Sentry MCP server
upstream_status_note: The repository was renamed from getsentry/sentry-mcp to getsentry/toolkit; the old address redirects. The npm package name is unchanged. Quoted: “ships the same server, bundled without the rest of the CLI, for clients that”.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C10; partly meets C1, C5, C8; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @sentry/mcp-server@0.49.0 names the repository `git+https://github.com/getsentry/toolkit.git`. The record carries no provenance attestation (`dist.attestations` is absent).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository, and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 0.49.0 is dated 2026-11-07; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-14; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-14.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The token scopes listed in the README include write scopes; the README documents limiting calls to one organisation or project and disabling skills. Quoted: “Pass `<org>/` or `<org>/<project>` to limit every call to one organization or”; “You can also disable any other skill to prevent unsupported tools from being”; “project:write”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Authentication is by a stored login or a token in an environment variable; the README marks the older command-line token flag as deprecated. Quoted: “SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=sentry-user-token npx @sentry/mcp-server@latest”; “`--access-token` / `SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN` from older releases still work but are”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`pnpm-lock.yaml`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.4.0 (and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.2) in the pnpm workspace catalog. Lower-bound version 2.4.0 of @modelcontextprotocol/server (npm) was published on 2026-10-23, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
